fusions.name: Unhurried Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out for 12 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Sleepy Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a pebble that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Afternoon
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 3 seconds, and your dodge chance rises by 10% for it.

fusions.name: Hanging Around
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
